patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ecwid and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Ecwid and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Ecwid only if your buying job matches “Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Bus” rather than Shopware's shape. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Ecwid's shape. Workflow advantage: Ecwid leans checkout-conversion; Shopware leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ecwid and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ecwid is Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Business $49, Unlimited $119 (post 2 Mar 2026 tiles);; Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote..
- Company-size focus: Ecwid (solo, micro, small-business) vs Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ecwid-leaning checkout-conversion vs Shopware-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Ecwid — Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV.

Limitations — Ecwid: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; POS / omnichannel is limited versus Lightspeed Retail or Square; Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting.

Poor-fit cases: Ecwid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products · Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Avoid Ecwid if you actually need Shopware's motion (Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Ris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
